content: .{@-मेधिन्@} {%m.%} a householder, a married Brāhmaṇa who has a household; (गृहैर्दारैर्मेधन्ते संगच्छन्ते <ls>Malli.</ls>); प्रजायै गृहमेधिनाम् <ls>R. 1. 7</ls>; see गृहपति above. ({@-नी@}) .²1 the wife of a householder, a house-wife; न व्यचष्ट वरारोहां गृहिणीं गृहमेधिनीम् <ls>Bhāg. 4. 26. 13</ls>. .²2 the intellect based on the Sattva quality.
